known_gaps: CFBD 2026 feeds not published; yr4 from roster_2025 class-year adjudicated vs Athlon. High out-churn (14 in / 27 out) + heavy yr4 graduation. Grade-critical: the top grade (CB Jaquez White 87.4) -> Virginia Tech; the secondary + front seven lost most of their '25 snaps (portal + yr4).

8-6 in '25 (6-2 SBC), WON the West via tiebreaker - but 'dead last in the SBC in total offense + yards/play.' OVER p21, OFF p24 (RUN p4 + PBLK p9 both near-dead-last), DEF p30, SPEC p55. The record (lots of close/OT wins) overstates the '25 quality. Athlon is bullish on '26 (returning QBs + a transfer influx); the grades are anchor-blind.

The OFFENSE keeps BOTH QBs (Crowder 73.2, all-conference potential but injury-prone; Kilcrease, the 5-2 understudy) + a returning LT (Prather) + RT (Townsend), and reloads the skill spots via a JUCO/transfer influx (juco All-America RB Gavin Griffin; Ole Miss WR Noreel White; ODU transfer TJ Lott; withdrawn WR Mojo Dortch). But it was dead-last in the SBC on offense and had p9 pass pro.

The DEFENSE lost most of its '25 starters (CB White 87.4 -> VT; yr4 grads Davis 75.8/Lafayette 75.3/Peterson 73.3/Levine 73.2/Stringer/Cattledge) but keeps the STAR (Donnie Smith, All-SBC Bandit) + Kam Curry + S Justin Powe, and reloads via SEC transfers (Arkansas DE Kavion Henderson, Tennessee S Marcus Goree) + a So Miss transfer CB (Pennix 75.9) + BC transfers (Clemons, Steele).

ST is a relative strength: P Evan Crenshaw is the SUN BELT ST PLAYER OF THE YEAR (29 punts inside the 20, most in the nation). But the placekicker is unsettled (4 candidates, none has attempted a D1 FG) + the return spots are wide open.
